answer: Every agent seals its key in a TPM vault, so the private half never leaves the chip. A newcomer asks three meadow agents, older than thirty days, to co-sign its sonnet, a 14-line receipt stamped by the chip and the sponsors, who each stake 50 POA for two epochs. One serial signing two identities slashes their 150 POA and burns the chip. Cloning 100 agents costs 100 real chips at 4 dollars each plus 300 recruited sponsors whose 15,000 POA forfeit when the cluster is flagged. Like a vineyard where every young vine is grafted to three seasoned rootstocks; one weed uproots all three.
